doc: I87 (= I45a): the audit loop's policy (whitepaper §9.1, §9.2(6), §9.5, §12.3, L7, L19; BUILD_PLAN I45 and row I87; HUMAN_ANSWERS Q9). The contract is the docstring of tests_m3/test_audit_loop.py. It names no law, action, register or target: everything it selects is selected by rule, subform, binder type or witness shape.

convergence.k_why: BUILD_PLAN I45's exit: 3 consecutive rounds with no high-priority finding
convergence.same_family: HUMAN_ANSWERS Q9: a same-family round is labelled "same" and never counted; a high-priority finding it lists still resets the streak (CV3), and an open high finding still blocks (CV4)
convergence.fresh_session: L19: a counted round's auditor session differs from the session of every earlier round of the milestone

A1.name: mutation
A1.what: Plant realistic misimplementations in the real code the facts documents are extracted from (off-by-one offsets, missing clears, wrong masks, swapped cursors), re-extract, and confirm the corresponding obstruction appears. A miss is an extraction gap or a rule gap (whitepaper §9.5 A1).

A2.name: hostile input
A2.what: Attack R^ext at every interface carrier through public entry points: totality and panic defects, and whether the model's partiality matches the code's (whitepaper §9.5 A2).

A3.name: regression
A3.what: Compare law sets, premises and proof strengths across commits: dropped laws, strengthened hypotheses, drifted constants (whitepaper §9.5 A3; holon audit regress).

A4.name: vacuity and over-strength
A4.what: Check that premises are satisfiable and their inhabitants representative rather than degenerate, and that oracle hypotheses survive tests against the real oracles (whitepaper §9.5 A4, §12.3).

degenerate_rules.D1: a law with a State or Reach binder: the inhabitant's state is the initial state (a {steps} witness has one step, the law's own; a {prefix, x} witness has an empty prefix; a witness of state binders has every run empty)
degenerate_rules.D2: a law with two state binders: its two runs are identical (a {prefix, x} witness names one run, used for both; {runs: [r1, r2]} with r1 == r2; two state binders with equal runs)
degenerate_rules.D3: a law with no State or Reach binder: every byte the premises leave free is zero (the premises' field equalities taken as classes; a pin field == bytes fixes its class)

representative.linked_fill_why: holon.gen.linked's deterministic fill (i mod 255) + 1: every byte nonzero before the premise classes apply
representative.state: not searched by I87: no state-law representative search exists here; the I45 round's A4 auditor searches

hash_oracles.keccak256: Ethereum Keccak-256 (holon/keccak.py; the instrument uses tests_m2/_keccak.py)

rule_gaps.approval: a gpg signature over the candidate line without its approval field (holon.statement_diff.signed_payload), verified against a key the human froze (holon.statement_diff.verify_signature); agents never freeze a key (AGENTS.md rule 1), so no agent can approve
